extra.final_summary: The data had several issues: (1) 7 rows with variant or misspelled species labels (e.g., 'adelie', 'Gentoo ', 'Adeile', 'Chinstarp') were normalized to the allowed labels 'Adelie', 'Gentoo', and 'Chinstrap' using normalize_labels. (2) The 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,750'), so it was converted to numeric using cast_numeric. (3) One row (row 36) had an invalid flipper length of -200 mm, which is below the minimum allowed 170 mm; this row was excluded. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 50,825 g, Chinstrap: 35,900 g, Gentoo: 103,500 g.
